root.label: EPA announces repeal of Biden power plant emissions rule

events.label: EPA announces repeal of Biden power plant emissions rule

slots.name: rule status
slots.sentence: The EPA last month announced it would revoke the Biden-era rule, adding that it would take another step to keep future administrations from regulating pollution from power plants.

events.label: States sue over EPA power plant emissions repeal

slots.name: industry cost savings
slots.sentence: The EPA told news agencies that it does not comment on pending litigation, but it has said the repeal would save more than $300 billion in costs for the industry and "unleash" American energy.

slots.name: lawsuit status
slots.sentence: The group, led by New York, are suing the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency, arguing the nation will be put back decades and the climate crisis will worsen by "gutting one of the country's most significant protections."

slots.name: coalition members
slots.sentence: The coalition includes the states of New York, Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Delaware, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, New Jersey, New Mexico, North Carolina, Oregon, Rhode Island, Vermont, Washington, and Wisconsin. The cities include New York City, Chicago, Denver, and Washington, D.C.
